name: raizen-norms
description: Settle an app one layer at a time and hold it there: app-settle for the domain, the stack, the docs/ documents, and existing code brought back onto these rules; logic-settle for the layer between database and UI; design-settle for the visual direction and DESIGN.md. Session norms, git and destructive-operation guards, and document, UI, database, application-logic and build-order rules govern every session after.
